name: Pot of Awakening

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: Plant a shrub in it and in 30 days it becomes an Awakened Shrub.
text: If you plant an ordinary shrub in this 10-pound clay pot and let it grow for 30 days, the shrub magically transforms into an Awakened Shrub at the end of that time. (No other effect in the game.)
